15710.q: Which historic capital is famous for Gyeongbokgung Palace and was built at the start of the Joseon Dynasty?
15710.e: Hanyang (한양) was the capital founded by the Joseon Dynasty in 1394. It became modern Seoul. Gyeongbokgung was the main royal palace built there.

15708.q: What event destroyed the original Tripitaka Koreana in the 13th century?
15708.e: The Mongol invasions of the 13th century destroyed the original. Koreans remade the work on more than 80,000 wooden blocks, which are still preserved at Haeinsa.

15707.q: What is the name of the 1980 pro-democracy movement that ended in a brutal massacre under South Korea's military dictatorship?
15707.e: The Gwangju Uprising (광주 민주화 운동) of May 1980 was a pro-democracy movement brutally suppressed under General Chun Doo-hwan, resulting in hundreds of deaths.

15706.q: Which printing technology was developed in Korea before Gutenberg, during the Goryeo period?
15706.e: Korea developed metal movable type around 1230 CE, more than 200 years before Gutenberg in Europe. The "Jikji" (1377) is the oldest surviving book printed with metal movable type.

15705.q: What was the name of the Korean kingdom in the Middle Ages that gave rise to the name "Korea" in Western languages?
15705.e: The Goryeo dynasty (고려, 918–1392) gave rise to the name "Korea": Arab and Persian merchants traded with that kingdom and carried the name to the West.

15704.q: Which Korean empress was assassinated by Japanese agents in 1895?
15704.e: Empress Myeongseong (명성황후), also known as "Queen Min", was assassinated by Japanese agents at Gyeongbok Palace in October 1895.

15702.q: In what year did South Korea co-host the FIFA World Cup, reaching the semifinals?
15702.e: The 2002 World Cup was co-hosted by South Korea and Japan. South Korea surprised the world by reaching the semifinals, the best result ever by an Asian national team.

15701.q: Which Korean admiral is legendary for defeating the Japanese naval invasion in the 16th century with "turtle ships"?
15701.e: Admiral Yi Sun-sin (이순신) is Korea's most revered military hero, famous for using the geobukseon (turtle ships) to defend the country during the Japanese invasions of 1592–1598.

15700.q: What is the name of the Korean state legendarily founded by Dangun more than 4,000 years ago?
15700.e: Gojoseon (고조선, "Old Joseon") is the first Korean state, legendarily founded by Dangun in 2333 BCE, and is the root of Korean national identity.

15699.q: Which three kingdoms made up the period that preceded Korean unification?
15699.e: The Three Kingdoms period (삼국 시대) consists of Goguryeo (north), Baekje (southwest) and Silla (southeast), which existed from roughly 57 BCE to 668 CE.

15698.q: Which city hosted the 1988 Summer Olympics?
15698.e: Seoul hosted the 1988 Summer Olympics, a milestone for South Korea that showed the country's modernization to the world.

15697.q: Who was the first president of the Republic of Korea (South Korea)?
15697.e: Syngman Rhee (이승만) was the first president of the Republic of Korea, serving from 1948 to 1960, when he resigned after the April Revolution protests.

15696.q: What is the name of the Korean independence movement against Japanese occupation that began on March 1, 1919?
15696.e: The March 1st Movement (삼일운동, Sam-il Undong) of 1919 was one of the first public demonstrations of resistance to Japanese occupation, with thousands of Koreans taking to the streets to demand independence.

15695.q: What was the "Miracle on the Han River"?
o: South Korea's rapid industrialization and economic growth
15695.e: The "Miracle on the Han River" (한강의 기적) refers to South Korea's extraordinary economic growth after the Korean War, going from one of the poorest countries to one of the largest economies in just decades.

15694.q: Which power colonized Korea from 1910 to 1945?
15694.e: Japan colonized Korea from 1910 to 1945, a period of severe cultural suppression and economic exploitation that ended with Japan's defeat in World War II.

15693.q: When did the Korean War begin?
15693.e: The Korean War began on June 25, 1950, when North Korea invaded South Korea. The conflict lasted until the armistice of July 1953.

15692.q: In what year was Korea divided into North and South?
15692.e: The division of Korea took place in 1945, after the end of World War II, along the 38th parallel north. The North came under Soviet influence and the South under American influence.

15691.q: Which Korean king is considered one of history's greatest monarchs for creating Hangul?
15691.e: King Sejong the Great (세종대왕, r. 1418–1450) is considered Korea's greatest monarch, responsible for creating Hangul and for major scientific and cultural advances.

15690.q: Which dynasty ruled Korea for more than 500 years, until 1897?
15690.e: The Joseon Dynasty (조선) ruled Korea from 1392 to 1897.

15862.q: Which president is famous for the "Miracle on the Han River", Korea's economic growth?
15862.e: Park Chung-hee (1961–1979) led South Korea's rapid economic growth, the "Miracle on the Han River".

15860.q: Which kingdom unified the Korean peninsula for the first time?
15860.e: The Kingdom of Silla unified Korea in 668 CE, establishing the Unified Silla period.

15866.q: In what year did South Korea formally become a democracy?
15866.e: In 1987 the Constitution was revised to guarantee direct elections, marking the democratic transition.

15875.q: In what year did a Korean win the Nobel Peace Prize?
15875.e: Kim Dae-jung received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2000 for his efforts toward reconciliation with North Korea.

o: Protests that led to the impeachment of President Park Geun-hye
15885.e: The Candlelight Movement brought millions to the streets demanding the impeachment of Park Geun-hye, which was carried out in 2017.

15882.q: What was the outcome of the Cairo Conference (1943) regarding Korea?
o: It declared that Korea would be independent after the war
It divided Korea into zones of influence
It handed Korea to American control
15882.e: The Cairo Declaration (1943) promised that Korea would be free and independent "in due course" after Japan's defeat.

15872.q: What was the main cause of the Japanese invasion of Korea in 1592?
o: Toyotomi Hideyoshi was trying to conquer China by passing through Korea
15872.e: Toyotomi Hideyoshi invaded Korea in 1592 (the Imjin War), using it as a route to conquer China.

15874.q: What was the role of the "chaebols" in Korea's economic development?
o: Large family-run conglomerates that led industrialization
15874.e: Chaebols such as Samsung, Hyundai and LG were fundamental to South Korea's rapid industrialization.

15881.q: What was the Gabo Reform movement (1894–1896)?
o: A series of modernizing reforms that abolished Korea's caste system
15881.e: The Gabo Reforms abolished slavery and the caste system and modernized several Korean institutions.

26303.e: He played Choi Taek, the baduk genius, in 'Reply 1988' (2015–2016).

26293.q: In which 2016–2017 drama was the character played by this actor the swimmer Jung Joon-hyung, romantic partner of a weightlifter?
26293.e: Nam Joo-hyuk played the swimmer Jung Joon-hyung in 'Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo' (2016–2017), opposite Lee Sung-kyung.

26282.q: In the award-winning 2022 drama, what is the main character constantly fascinated by and uses as a visual metaphor during trials?
26282.e: The character Woo Young-woo has a hyper-focused interest in whales, which appear as a visual metaphor at the turning points of her cases.

26278.q: In which 2022 drama, about an attorney with autism who loves whales, did this actress gain international recognition?
26278.e: The actress played Woo Young-woo, an attorney with autism and a fascination with whales, in 'Extraordinary Attorney Woo' (2022).

26276.q: In the popular romantic drama "True Beauty" (2020–2021), he plays the school heartthrob named:
26276.e: He plays Lee Soo-ho, one of the leads of "True Beauty", opposite Moon Ga-young.

26274.q: In which year did the group ASTRO, of which he is the vocalist and visual, debut with the EP "Spring Up"?
26274.e: ASTRO debuted in February 2016 with the EP "Spring Up".

26268.q: In the drama "Lovely Runner" (2024), set across two time periods, the actor plays an idol named:
26268.e: In "Lovely Runner", the actor plays the idol Ryu Sun-jae, the character that launched his international career.

26202.q: In which 2019 series did singer and actress IU play Jang Man-wol, the owner of a hotel for ghosts?
26202.e: In Hotel Del Luna (tvN, 2019), IU plays Jang Man-wol, bound to the hotel for a thousand years, opposite Yeo Jin-goo.

26200.q: In Crash Landing on You, the character played by Hyun Bin is an army officer of which country?
26200.e: Ri Jeong-hyeok is a captain in the North Korean army and hides Yoon Se-ri after she lands there by paraglider.

26199.q: Which children's game opens the first challenge of Squid Game?
26199.e: In the first challenge, anyone caught moving during the red light is eliminated.

15588.q: Which actress starred in "Crash Landing on You" opposite Hyun Bin?
15588.e: Son Ye-jin played Yoon Se-ri. She and Hyun Bin married in real life in 2022.

15669.q: Which "Squid Game" characters became famous for their pink uniforms and black masks?
15669.e: The guards in "Squid Game" wear pink uniforms with black masks in geometric shapes (triangle, square, circle), which made them a visual icon.

15662.q: Which pair of K-drama actors became famous as an "OTP" (One True Pairing) in "Descendants of the Sun"?
15662.e: Song Joong-ki and Song Hye-kyo became K-drama's most famous couple in 2016 with "Descendants of the Sun", and even married in real life (divorcing in 2019).

15657.q: Which 2014 K-drama with Kim Soo-hyun as an alien became a phenomenon in Asia?
15657.e: "My Love from the Star" (2013–2014), with Kim Soo-hyun as an alien who arrived on Earth 400 years earlier, was a huge hit across Asia.

15654.q: Which historical K-drama set in the Joseon era combines politics and zombies?
15654.e: "Kingdom" (Netflix, 2019) is a historical thriller set in the Joseon era that mixes court politics with a zombie epidemic.

15653.q: Which 2019 K-drama tells the story of a young South Korean woman who accidentally lands in North Korea?
15653.e: "Crash Landing on You" (tvN, 2019) tells the story of Yoon Se-ri, who accidentally lands in North Korea and falls in love with an army officer.

15652.q: Which K-drama starring Son Ye-jin and Hyun Bin led them to marry in real life?
15652.e: "Crash Landing on You" (2019–2020) brought Son Ye-jin and Hyun Bin together; they married in March 2022 and had a son.

15650.q: Which actor played the protagonist Gi-hun in "Squid Game"?
15650.e: Lee Jung-jae played Seong Gi-hun, number 456, the protagonist of "Squid Game". He also won the Emmy for Best Actor for the role.

15593.q: Which actor starred in both "Goblin" and "Train to Busan"?
15593.e: Gong Yoo starred in "Goblin" (2016) and "Train to Busan" (2016), two landmarks of Korean entertainment.

15590.q: In which drama did Lee Min-ho play Gu Jun-pyo?
15590.e: "Boys Over Flowers" (2009) made Lee Min-ho internationally famous.

26344.q: On which South Korean broadcaster did Itaewon Class originally air, between January and March 2020?
26344.e: Itaewon Class aired on JTBC from January 31 to March 21, 2020, and was also distributed worldwide by Netflix.

26340.q: On which broadcaster was True Beauty originally aired in South Korea?
26340.e: True Beauty premiered on tvN on December 9, 2020, with weekly episodes on Wednesdays and Thursdays.

26339.q: Kingdom was the first Korean original series produced by which streaming platform?
26339.e: Kingdom marked Netflix's debut in Korean original productions, released in January 2019.

26336.q: In what year did this zombie series set in the Joseon dynasty premiere on Netflix?
26336.e: Kingdom premiered on Netflix on January 25, 2019, as the platform's first Korean original series.

26332.q: Which actress plays Seo Dal-mi, the protagonist who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur?
26332.e: Bae Suzy plays Seo Dal-mi, an ambitious young woman who dreams of becoming Korea's 'Steve Jobs'.

26328.q: On which streaming platform was this South Korean series about a zombie outbreak inside a school released worldwide in January 2022?
26328.e: The series was released in all Netflix markets on January 28, 2022.

26324.q: Which actor plays the protagonist of this series about an Italian-Korean lawyer tied to the mafia who returns to South Korea?
26324.e: Song Joong-ki plays Vincenzo Cassano, a consigliere of the Italian mafia who returns to South Korea, in the series of the same name.

26321.q: Which actor plays Goo Chan-sung, the human manager recruited to run Hotel del Luna alongside Man-wol?
26321.e: Yeo Jin-goo plays Goo Chan-sung, the manager hired by Man-wol to run the hotel's administration.

26319.q: On which broadcaster did Hospital Playlist originally air, starting in 2020?
26319.e: Hospital Playlist premiered in 2020 on tvN, the same broadcaster that aired the second season in 2021.

26317.q: What is the name of the amateur band formed by the five doctor friends in Hospital Playlist?
26317.e: The five doctors form an amateur band called Mido and Falasol, which performs inside the hospital itself.

32901.q: Kim Jong-kook became popular worldwide as a regular cast member of which variety show?
32901.e: Running Man gave Kim Jong-kook great international popularity.

32855.q: In 2022, which role made Yoon Chan-young known outside Korea, in All of Us Are Dead?
32855.e: Yoon Chan-young plays Lee Cheong-san in All of Us Are Dead (2022).

32831.q: Which character does Seo Ji-hye play in Crash Landing on You (2019)?
32831.e: Seo Ji-hye plays the romantic rival Seo Dan in Crash Landing on You.

33011.q: Park Na-rae became a regular host of which program, starting in 2013, the format that defined her career?
33011.e: I Live Alone (2013) is the show that established Park Na-rae's career.

32965.q: Park Myung-hoon played Geun-sae, the man hidden in the basement, in which film that won the Oscar for Best Picture in 2020?
32965.e: Park Myung-hoon plays Geun-sae in Parasite (2019), by Bong Joon-ho.

32950.q: Jee Seok-jin is a regular member of which SBS urban-action variety program?
32950.e: Jee Seok-jin has been a regular member of Running Man since 2010.
